title: Enduro championships, gate banners and compass
summary: Amateur and Pro Enduro championships implemented; each gate's banners show turn arrows with selective fading; original Enduro compass is heading-up radar; race track window corrected to 125 ft ahead / 75 ft behind.
details: Amateur and Pro Enduro championships (Amateur races each venue's short Enduro, Pro the long one, three laps, same points/advance/trophy/reward rules; a trophy in Amateur opens Pro). An Enduro now also ends for everyone 30 s after the first rider finishes, as in the original. Each gate's banners show the original turn arrow toward the next gate (22.5° bins, front and back faces); every gate but the rider's next one draws at 40% opacity. The original Enduro compass is a heading-up radar with the player arrow, other riders as dots and the next gate's icon within about 333 ft. Race track window is 125 ft ahead / 75 ft behind (the original race loader overwrites the 200 ft constructor value)—affects all National/Supercross races' progress window and lap test. Unit tests and browser tests (test_engine_championship_enduro, test_engine_championship, test_engine_championship_loading, test_engine_enduro_race, race/finish-gate/grid tests) pass; screenshots inspected. Host-only.
limitation: Enduro content must be published by the release owner first; CPUs and the test autopilot follow the course route line and can stall (one test round ended through the 30 s rule); gate fading not visually confirmed in captures; compass arrow tint unverified; Short Tracks and Freestyle championships not offered.
